scope: design and host integration contract; no runtime service implemented

pending.close: dismiss view only; retain operation; no Cancel label

failed.requires: definitive rejection AND authoritative membership still in original team

unknown.requires: timeout, lost response or process interruption; block new leave request until reconciled

offline.behavior: no offline queue or optimistic removal

leader_transfer_required.requires: explicit server reason; do not infer from visible leader badge

already_left.route: existing Find Team if authoritative no-team membership

different_team.behavior: do not clear the newer team or automatically leave it

requestPolicy: Capture teamId and expected membership version on confirmation.
Prevent duplicate taps while pending. Persist pending operation identity across suspend/relaunch.
On timeout query the same operation and refresh membership; never generate another request solely because a timer elapsed.
Definitive retry uses server idempotency semantics; never blindly reuse a cached failed result or duplicate an unknown operation.
Keep pending state outside view lifetime. Closing the modal does not cancel an accepted server operation.
Guard against stale responses using account ID, team ID, membership version and operation ID.
Confirmed departure invalidates only old team-scoped chat/help/mail caches, not global inbox, player progress, coins or inventory.
If caller is dismissed while request is pending, reconcile foreground membership and route appropriately on confirmation.
previewData: Names, counts and response delays are fixtures. No real team or account mutation.
